prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Night Symbols, Surreal dream symbolism. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Muted midnight blue with warm clay gold, smooth enamel and glass. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read curious threshold dreamer. stubby oversized brass key with a round handle. thin sideways comma, bright lifted eyes and parted smile.
2. Male-read confused impossible-stair traveller. small impossible stair sculpture cupped in both hands. wide squat blob, off-axis eyes and small O mouth.
3. Male-read delighted moon collector. tiny smooth crescent resting upright in a pale teacup. round high pear, pleased upward gaze and open asymmetric grin.
4. Female-read uneasy maze navigator. single red thread wound around a palm-sized clay labyrinth tile. tall soft oval, knitted brows and tight frown.
5. Male-read doubtful mirror bearer. small silver-backed hand mirror angled outward, smooth face with abstract reflection. broad uneven splat, sidelong eyes and compressed lips.
6. Male-read weary time dreamer. short clean glass hourglass with homogeneous warm clay sand volume. drooping upright bean, sleepy lids and tiny wavy mouth.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.
